digo: Mdanga tsongo (Mdzenga tsongo); Muoga ivu (also Mzengatsongo, Chikuro)
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005

teaser.en: Children use the dark juice of its berries as ink, and weaver birds love to settle in its branches.
teaser.sw: Watoto hutumia maji meusi ya matunda yake kama wino, na manyanje (ndege wafumaji) hupenda kutua katika matawi yake.
teaser.dg: Ana nkuhumira madzi maru ga matundage dza wino, na tsongo anamendza kudulama pandaze.

summary.en: *Mdanga tsongo* is the tassel berry, a bush shrub hung with bunches of berries that ripen from red to near black. Its fruit is eaten, its juice used by children as ink, and its leaves and roots as medicine.
summary.sw: *Mdanga tsongo* (kwa Kiingereza *tassel berry*) ni kichaka cha vichakani kilichoning'iniza vishada vya matunda yanayoiva kutoka mekundu hadi karibu meusi. Matunda yake huliwa, maji yake hutumiwa na watoto kama wino, na majani na mizizi yake kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Mdanga tsongo* ni chitsaka cha weruni chenye makundi ga matunda madide ganayoivwa kula ga kundu hadi kukala maru-maru. Matundage nkuriwa, madzige nkuhumirwa ni ana dza wino, na makodzage na miziye nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

about.en: *Mdanga tsongo* is a shrub or small tree with elliptic leaves that are hairy beneath. Its tiny flowers hang in drooping spikes, the 'tassels' of its English name. These become bunches of small berries that ripen unevenly, so a single bunch can show white, red and almost-black fruit at once.
about.sw: *Mdanga tsongo* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya umbo la duaradufu yenye vinyweleo upande wa chini. Maua yake madogo sana huning'inia kwa mashada yanayolegea, 'vishada' (*tassels*) vya jina lake la Kiingereza. Hayo hugeuka kuwa vishada vya matunda madogo yanayoiva bila mpangilio, kwa hiyo kishada kimoja kinaweza kuwa na matunda meupe, mekundu na karibu meusi kwa wakati mmoja.
about.dg: *Mdanga tsongo* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ga umbo ra yayi genye nyere photsi. Maruwage madide sana ganabwadzika kpwa milita, ndigo 'tassels' za dzinare ra Chingereza. Higa ganakala makundi ga matunda madide ganayoivwa bila kulingana, kpwa hivyo kundi rimwenga rinaweza kukala na matunda mereru, ga kundu na maru-maru kpwa wakati mmwenga.

where.en: It grows in bushland and on forest edges.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na pembezoni mwa misitu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

uses.en: The ripe berries are eaten, and children use the dark fruit juice as ink. Leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine, and the wood is made into tool handles.
uses.sw: Matunda yaliyoiva huliwa, na watoto hutumia maji meusi ya matunda kama wino. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji, na mbao zake hutengenezwa mipini ya zana.
uses.dg: Matunda maivu nkuriwa, na ana nkuhumira madzi maru ga matunda dza wino. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na nyama za muhi nkutsongwa kuhenda miphini ya vifaa.

culture.en: *Mdanga tsongo* means 'settling place of weaver birds', a name that pictures noisy flocks gathering in the bush.
culture.sw: *Mdanga tsongo* lina maana ya 'mahali pa kutua manyanje', jina linalochora picha ya makundi ya ndege wenye kelele wakikusanyika vichakani.
culture.dg: *Mdanga tsongo* maanaye ni 'phatu pha kudulama tsongo', dzina rinarochora makundi ga tsongo ganayopiga kululu ganayokusanyika weruni.

names.en: This shrub has many Digo names. Pakia records *mdanga tsongo* (also *mdzenga tsongo*) and *muoga ivu*; ICRAF and the Mgombato dictionary give *mzengatsongo* or *mdzengatsongo*, and *chikuro*. Mgombato lists the Swahili as *mziwaziwa*, *msuaga*, *mbuanono* and *karacha*; Swahili also has *msasuzi*. In Giriama it is *mhirondo* or *msimbiji*, and in English tassel berry.
names.sw: Kichaka hiki kina majina mengi ya Kidigo. Pakia anarekodi *mdanga tsongo* (pia *mdzenga tsongo*) na *muoga ivu*; ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato vinatoa *mzengatsongo* au *mdzengatsongo*, na *chikuro*. Mgombato inaorodhesha majina ya Kiswahili *mziwaziwa*, *msuaga*, *mbuanono* na *karacha*; Kiswahili kina pia *msasuzi*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mhirondo* au *msimbiji*, na kwa Kiingereza *tassel berry*.
names.dg: Chitsaka chihi china madzina manji ga Chidigo. Pakia anaandika *mdanga tsongo* (piya *mdzenga tsongo*) na *muoga ivu*; chitabu cha ICRAF na Mgombato vinapha *mzengatsongo* au *mdzengatsongo*, na *chikuro*. Mgombato unaandika madzina ga Chiswahili *mziwaziwa*, *msuaga*, *mbuanono* na *karacha*; Chiswahili piya china *msasuzi*. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *mhirondo* au *msimbiji*, na kpwa Chingereza ni *tassel berry*.

reason.sw: Mviru (*wild medlar*), tunda jingine la vichakani

mgombato: chikuro (vi) type of plant (Antidesma venosum); mziwaziwa, msuaga, mbuanono, karacha. (See: mdzengatsongo)
mdzengatsongo (mi) type of plant (Antidesma venosum); mziwaziwa, msuaga, mbuanono, karacha. (See: chikuro)
